audit.whatIsWrong: The page states in four places that Pantheon's passive blocks your first auto-attack, so Staggering Blow 'never roots'. Riot's text for Mortal Will (P) is only: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' There is no auto-block in his kit.
audit.why: This is the load-bearing claim of the whole early-game section and it is false, so the advice built on it ('his shield eats your engage auto') sends the player to the wrong conclusion. His actual early strength is Shield Vault (W): a 600-range point-click dash-stun on a 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown that is also an auto-attack reset, so the damage arrives on the wind-up rather than on a readable cast.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will empowers every few spells or attacks; Shield Vault is the point-click dash-stun that opens his trade and resets his auto.
sources: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json (P text, W flags and cooldowns)

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 3 are marked Skill in a lane Nautilus wins 36.84% of, and row 4 is marked Skill even though the mid text calls level 6 'your one real swing'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Nautilus / Pantheon / Pantheon — Pantheon owns everything except your level 6 window, which is exactly what the prose describes.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Pantheon, row 3 to Pantheon, row 4 to Nautilus, in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match.

audit.why: Spike ladder is right: his level 1-2 dominance, his level 3, your level 6 Depth Charge, his lethality first item.
audit.corrected: Only spikes[0]'s wording changed, to name the real ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is never explained. The page never says it is a channel, never says it only blocks damage from the front, and never tells the player that your CC cancels it.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is a 400-range, 22/21/20/19/18s channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the front only. Dredge Line's pull and Depth Charge's knockup are displacement and hard CC — they land through it and cancel the channel. The mirror audit found the Pantheon side of this page telling its player the opposite, that Aegis Assault blocks the hook.
audit.corrected: Don't dump damage into the front of Aegis Assault; the hook's pull or Depth Charge cancels the 22s channel outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: Header says TRICKY 7.5/10 for a 36.84% matchup over 19 games where the chart gives Pantheon six of seven rows.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are brutal here. His Aegis passive blocks your first Staggering Blow auto, which means your passive root just doesn't proc, and he point-click stuns you with W before you can do anything. Don't walk up to last-hit in his Q spear range expecting to trade, because his shield eats your engage auto and his stun locks you for his combo. Hold your Q for a clean hook from the brush or when he steps up to poke, never throw it as an opener he can simply stun you out of.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are brutal here. Shield Vault is a point-click dash-stun on a 13s cooldown and it resets his auto, so his burst arrives on the wind-up with no cast for you to react to. Don't walk up to last-hit inside Comet Spear's 575 range expecting to trade — he stuns first and Mortal Will empowers whatever follows. Hold your hook for a clean angle out of brush or for his step-up, never as an opener he can simply stun you out of.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he keeps the edge with empowered Q spears and his W stun reset, so play for farm and your W shield to soak the poke rather than forcing trades you lose. Level 6 is your one real swing: Depth Charge is a homing, undodgeable knock-up that his Aegis shield can't block and he can't dash out of, so chain R into Q pull into E slow for your only clean kill window. Use it the moment he uses W aggressively or set it up with your jungler, because off cooldown you're back to losing the short trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he keeps the edge with empowered spears and Shield Vault's reset, so farm and let Titan's Wrath soak the poke instead of forcing trades you lose. When he sets Aegis Assault, do not pour damage into the front of it — it is a 22s channel, and your pull or Depth Charge cancels it outright. Level 6 is your one real swing: Depth Charge homes, cannot be dodged, and he has no dash out, so chain R into pull into Riptide the moment his W is spent.
